newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALLINN HEATING, WATER ISSUE CPS.
newsitem.headline: TALLINN HEATING, WATER ISSUE CPS.

text.p: Tallinn Heating and Tallinn Water will issue new commercial papers in July, Hansapank said on Monday.
Tallinn Heating will on July 30 issue 35 million kroons in three-month commercial paper yielding 7.7 percent, the bank's interest rate products manager Ulo Kallas said.
Tallinn Water will on July 29 issue 40 million kroons in three-month commercial papers with a yield of 7.0 percent.
Kallas added that Hansa Liising today increased its commercial paper issue of 40 million kroons to 45 million kroons. The paper, maturing in one and half months, yields 6.3 percent.
